title: SCA Minhag of the Week 175: "The Morning of the Sebbit in Knis"

chapters.title: Greeting the family in the kenis
chapters.about: Seating and greeting those celebrating a sebet

chapters.title: Timing and attendance customs
chapters.about: Prayer times and the custom of joining the family's kenis

summary: Mr. Mosseri discusses the customs observed in the kenis on the morning of a Shabbat when a family is celebrating a sebet. He explains the traditional practices regarding seating, greeting the family, and the importance of guests joining the family at their synagogue to enhance the joy of the occasion.
questions: How should one greet a family celebrating a sebet in the kenis?
Do people celebrating a sebet have a special role in the prayers?
Is it customary to pray in a different kenis to join a family's sebet?
How are aliyot determined for those celebrating a sebet?
